edits.before: RQ the carry at wave contact, tether the answer, walk — the chip leads the lane's ledger.
edits.after: He needs a landed Winter's Bite to even start Concussive Blows — sidestep the Q and his whole engage plan is dead for its 8-6s cooldown.

edits.before: Spending mantra on a wave while the enemy banks theirs for your face.
edits.after: He has no kill pressure once E Unbreakable and R are down — trading at even HP just lets his ADC catch up for free.

edits.before: - Braum Unbreakable: matchup-defining — The shield wall eats your poke and engage projectiles — wait it out. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your RE shield-speed answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Winter's Bite (Q) is 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s — his only ranged tool and the only way he starts Concussive Blows; dodge it and he has nothing. - E Unbreakable is 16/14/12/10/8s and blocks one direction of projectiles — bait it before committing Inner Flame. - R Glacial Fissure (130/115/100s) is disengage, not a kill threat.
